row: Welcome to the Youtube channel of the Harmony Fund international animal rescue charity.  We are a USA-based charity throwing a lifeline to underdog animal rescue squads all over the planet.  We help feed homeless animals on the street, sponsor care in shelters, host spay/neuter campaigns, provide emergency veterinary care, protect wildlife in their habitat and fight cruelty internationally.
